# XINJE TouchWin WinUSB bridge for Windows ARM64

> Independent project by Ignacio Norambuena (archidemus). Normal TG765-ET USB-B download verified with TouchWin v2.E.9_241018 on Windows 11 ARM64 in VMware Fusion on Apple Silicon. Not an official XINJE driver.

- [Author: Ignacio Norambuena — archidemus.me](https://archidemus.me/): project author and maintainer.
- [Repository](https://github.com/archidemus/touchwin-winusb-arm64): source, issues and pull requests.
- [README](README.md): installation, compatibility, build, troubleshooting and direct FAQ answers.
- [Validation](evidence/validation.json): dated evidence and DLL hash.
- [Source](easyusb_winusb.c): x86 DLL using Microsoft's native WinUSB transport.
- [License](LICENSE): custom community terms with XINJE restrictions.
- [Licensing explanation](LICENSING.md): official-mention conditions and legal limits.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): community workflow.
- [Contributor agreement](CONTRIBUTOR_AGREEMENT.md): express grant; contributors retain ownership.

Only normal download was validated. Other models, versions, upload and full download are unverified. Second port unsupported.
Source available, not OSI-approved open source. Copyright licensing cannot guarantee banning every factual mention or link.
Contact: ignacio@archidemus.me.
